comments.author: jitl
comments.story: Apple is open sourcing Swift Build
comments.why: WWDC session proposing Swift for smart home devices.
comments.text: Although opinions inside Apple about Swift vary, they seem to be investing in low level Swift for embedded, kernel use, and programming the “Secure Enclave” subsystem. They certainly have many opportunities to use it for headphones, AirTag, flash driver, etc, beyond the very believable but less embedded use in kernel/Secure Enclave. See also the wwdc session where they propose swift for building smart home thingies [VIDEO]
